summary: Iteration 8 testing: resizable tables (Clienti/Vendite/Cassa), cash-sync endpoint, cash<->sales/repairs/parts synchronization, blocked delete for linked cash movements, and part purchase movements + cash reference dialog. All backend (4/4 pytest) and frontend flows pass end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1600 lines; consider splitting by domain (customers, parts, sales, cash, refurb, catalog, backup) into routers to improve maintainability.
GET /api/cash executes sync_cash() on every request, which iterates over sales/repairs/parts collections. On larger data this may become slow; consider incremental sync or debouncing.

sync_cash() only removes orphan 'vendita' movements; orphan 'riparazione' or 'acquisto_ricambi' movements (e.g. if a part is deleted directly) are not cleaned. delete_part does not remove related cash_movements - stale rows can accumulate.

record_part_purchase is called on PUT when quantity increases even if cost_price is 0 (guarded amount<=0). OK, but tying purchase cost to current cost_price rather than the delta's cost at that time may misprice if cost changes between purchases.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed entities and clean them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login redirects to '/', not '/dashboard'; wait for 'Panoramica' text or a route selector. All resizable table testids follow pattern {section}-th-{i} and {section}-th-{i}-resizer; scroll container {section}-table-scroll; reset button reset-columns-{section}. Column widths persist via localStorage key colw:{section}. Cash sync toast text: 'Cassa già sincronizzata' when idempotent. delete_part does NOT cascade cash movements - potential minor issue.
